channel.description: The latest quotes about Simone Biles from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Simone Biles
item.description:
She put on a show in front of a packed Bercy Arena that left other superstars like USA Basketball legend Kevin Durant amazed by Biles' athleticism.

“I really believe Goat Biles can catch a lob and finish. #bounce,”

Kevin Durant on Simone Biles, Aug 1, 2024. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Simone Biles
item.description:
“So, for her to be at that age and still elite, of course, yeah, I want to go check her out. I've always been a fan of what she was doing. Introduced me to that sport, really. I wasn't really paying attention much until she started doing her thing. ... Simone is somebody who set the tone for what a champion, an Olympian, a winner in life should be.”

Kevin Durant on Simone Biles, Jul 8, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Simone Biles
item.description:
Dwain Price:Jalen Brunson on Simone Biles dropping out of the Olympic team competition:

“Good for her. Sometimes you need to tell yourself that “I need this.’I know that she wanted to be out there with her teammates but I think for her mental state she needed to do that and I applaud her for it.”

Jalen Brunson on Simone Biles, Jul 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.
